devdoc.author: Matrix-Hub Team
devdoc.details: Uses server seed commitment and client seed for verifiable randomness

commitServerSeed(bytes32).details: Only owner can commit to prevent manipulation

resolve(bytes).details: Only callable by CasinoCore, generates random result and increments nonce

returns._0: True if player wins, false otherwise

revealServerSeed(bytes32).details: Allows verification that server didn't cheat

returns._0: True if seed matches committed hash

setClientSeed(bytes32).details: Should be called by player to ensure provable fairness
